title: Standards Organisation of Nigeria Act, 2015
gazette_number: Federal Republic of Nigeria Official Gazette / Act No. 14 of 2015
description: An Act to repeal the Standards Organisation of Nigeria Act and provide for the standardization and quality control of products.

sections.section_title: Establishment of the Standards Organisation of Nigeria
sections.full_text:
(1) There is established a body to be known as the Standards Organisation of Nigeria (in this Act referred to as 'the Organisation').
(2) The Organisation—
(a) shall be a body corporate with perpetual succession and a common seal;
(b) may sue and be sued in its corporate name; and
(c) may acquire, hold or dispose of any property, whether movable or immovable.

sections.section_title: Establishment and composition of the Standards Council of Nigeria
sections.full_text:
(1) There is established for the Organisation a governing council to be known as the Standards Council of Nigeria (in this Act referred to as 'the Council').
(2) The Council shall consist of a Chairman and representatives of relevant Federal Ministries, organised private sector, academia, and consumer associations.

sections.section_title: Director-General to be administrative head of the Organisation
sections.full_text:
(1) Subject to the provisions of this Act, all acts of the Council and all questions arising before the Council shall be determined by a majority of the members present and voting at a meeting of the Council.

(2) The person presiding shall have original vote and, in the event of an equality of votes, shall have a second casting vote.

sections.section_title: Number of Directors and their duties
sections.full_text:
(1) The quorum of the Council shall be 5 and shall include at least 3 of the persons mentioned in subsection 3 (1) (b) and (c) of this Act.
(2) The quorum of any committee of the Council shall be determined by the Council.
(3) For the purpose of determining a quorum, members present shall be counted.
(4) Unless otherwise provided by the standing order of the Council, no business shall be transacted at any meeting unless a quorum is present at the time when the meeting proceeds to business and throughout the meeting.

sections.section_title: Exemption from liability in the course of employment
sections.full_text:
(1) The Council may appoint such technical and project committee as it deems fit to deal with specific materials or groups of materials or topics or such other tasks as the Council may direct any such committee to undertake.
(2) Each committee shall be presided over by a member of the Council and shall be made up of such number of experts not necessarily members of the Council, as may be determined in each case.
(3) Subject to its power to appoint technical and project committees in accordance with sub-paragraphs (1) and (2) of this paragraph, the Council shall appoint the following standing committees —
(a) Finance and General Purpose Committee;
(b) Appointment, Promotion and Disciplinary Committee; and
(c) Technical Committee.
(4) Each committee shall be presided over by a member of the Council.
(5) The Council may increase or reduce or otherwise vary the composition of the membership of each committee as it deems fit.
(6) The decision of any committee appointed under this paragraph is of no effect until it is ratified by the Council.

sections.section_title: Financial provisions and fund of the Organisation
sections.searchable_chunk:
Standards Organisation of Nigeria Act, 2015 - Section 15: Financial provisions and fund of the Organisation
General Provisions
(1) The Organisation shall establish and maintain a fund from which shall be defrayed all expenditure incurred by the Organisation.
(2) There shall be paid and credited to the fund established under subsection (1) of this section—
(a) budgetary allocations and subventions from the Federal Government;
(b) fees charged and revenue earned for services, certifications and laboratory analyses rendered by the Organisation;
(c) gifts, loans, grants-in-aid, testamentary dispositions and endowments from international organizations or partners.
